text: I believe you would sell your soul for money. I believe----” He paused, then in a low, sinister voice he said slowly: “Sometimes I believe that you would sell-- us!” Mrs. Vandemeyer smiled and shrugged her shoulders. “The price, at any rate, would have to be enormous,” she said lightly. “It would be beyond the power of anyone but a millionaire to pay.” “Ah!” snarled the Russian. “You see, I was right!” “My dear Boris, can you not take a joke?” “Was it a joke?” “Of course.” “Then all I can say is that your ideas of humour are peculiar, my dear Rita.” Mrs. Vandemeyer smiled.
